Simulated event-spanning option surfaces, 2016 U.S. election profile

Source: R/data.R
us2016_surfaces_sim.Rd

Simulated implied-volatility surfaces for event-spanning options around the 2016 U.S. presidential election (event date 2016-11-08), matching the empirical profile of S&P 500 index options over the last four pre-election weeks. Every implied volatility is generated from the lognormal event mixture of ec_mix_iv() plus Gaussian noise (sd 0.004); the generator is parametrized by estimation results only — a common log exposure \(\theta = -0.077\) and per-surface conditional dispersions and event probabilities fitted with ec_theta_fit() — so the dataset contains no third-party data values. 47 surfaces (valuation dates 2016-10-11 to 2016-11-07, expiries 2016-11-16/18/21) on a nine-point call-equivalent delta grid. The event probabilities are the Trump series of us2016.

Usage

us2016_surfaces_sim

Format

A tibble with 423 rows and 6 columns:

event_date

Election day (Date), 2016-11-08.

obs_date

Valuation date (Date).

expiry_date

Option expiry (Date), after the election.

node

Call-equivalent delta grid node (0.1-0.9).

iv

Simulated annualized Black implied volatility.

q

State-price-implied probability of a Trump win at obs_date (from us2016).

Source

Simulated; see data-raw/us2016_surfaces_sim.R. Calibration targets estimated from index-option surfaces around the 2016 election; used in the event-spanning vignette.

Examples

data(us2016_surfaces_sim)
head(us2016_surfaces_sim)
#> # A tibble: 6 × 6
#>   event_date obs_date   expiry_date  node    iv     q
#>   <date>     <date>     <date>      <dbl> <dbl> <dbl>
#> 1 2016-11-08 2016-10-11 2016-11-18    0.1 0.110 0.164
#> 2 2016-11-08 2016-10-11 2016-11-18    0.2 0.113 0.164
#> 3 2016-11-08 2016-10-11 2016-11-18    0.3 0.117 0.164
#> 4 2016-11-08 2016-10-11 2016-11-18    0.4 0.116 0.164
#> 5 2016-11-08 2016-10-11 2016-11-18    0.5 0.123 0.164
#> 6 2016-11-08 2016-10-11 2016-11-18    0.6 0.138 0.164
